text:
jess (support): FYI new private deployment intake from Finlytics. They want VPC + on-prem image + HSM integration + an offline installer option. Sales says projected ARR ~$140k. Customer asked for a 12-week timeline. Can product/solutions/infra triage?

mike (pm): Thanks Jess. Can we get the ask doc / acceptance criteria from sales? Need must-have vs nice-to-have.

sam (solutions): I grabbed the intake form — adding a quick tech sketch. Early flags: no KMS connector listed, no network egress policy, and they want signed images for air-gapped.

ana (infra): @sam do you mean custom packaging for air-gap? That usually adds ~4-6w infra effort.

sam (solutions): yep. Packaging + offline registry + validation flow.

ben (security): HSM integration is non-trivial — we need PKCS#11 support + key policy mapping. Also need to confirm whether customer-managed HSM or we broker keys.

triage-bot: New intake ticket created: #INC-2026-314 (Finlytics private deploy). Assigned: product + solutions + infra + security.

alex (product lead): Proposal for scope negotiation: MVP (phase 1) = VPC peering/VPN, private image registry, KMS integration (cloud KMS). Phase 2 = HSM, fully air-gapped installer, on-prem monitoring + advanced SIEM hooks. We can hit a safe 12w for MVP, but HSM+airgap pushes timeline.

jess (support): Customer prefers HSM early but said they'd accept a canary without HSM if non-PII traffic first. They want HSM for full production rollout.

mike (pm): OK. Decision rule: if contract ARR > $100k we include HSM in phase 1; otherwise HSM in phase 2. Also need signoff on data classification to allow canary without HSM.

sam (solutions): Tech dependency checklist (quick):
```
- Network: VPN/peering + firewall rules + DNS for private registry
- Identity: customer SSO / service account mapping
- Crypto: cloud KMS connector OR PKCS#11 HSM adapter
- Images: signed image pipeline + offline registry import tooling
- Ops: on-prem agent + metrics shipping (or sidecar)
- Compliance: access logging + key rotation policy
```

ana (infra): From infra POV estimated effort: MVP infra work 4w (VPN, registry, deploy scripts), KMS connector 1w, packaging pipeline 3w. HSM integration + testing 5-7w. Contingency + compliance reviews add 1-2w.

ben (security): Also add penetration test and HSM certification checks. We should require customer to provide HSM certs and admin contacts early.

alex (product lead): Launch criteria for phase 1 (MVP):
- Successful canary deploy in their staging VPC (latency & correctness)
- KMS keys configured and rotated in staging
- Signed images and registry access validated
- Customer acceptance test passed (basic failure scenarios)

mike (pm): Next steps: 1) Jess confirm sales will attach ARR & legal constraints 2) Sam to produce tech PRD with dependency list 3) Ana to scope infra tasks with ETA 4) Ben to add security checklist 5) Alex to draft phase plan and timeline. I'll sync with sales Tue EOD.

jess (support): Will ping sales to attach contract numbers and data classification. Also asked customer about HSM vendor (they mentioned Thales).

sam (solutions): I'll draft the tech PRD and include a minimal runbook for canary without HSM. ETA: EOW.

ana (infra): I'll add tasks to infra board and tag required capacity. ETA for work breakdown: 48h.

ben (security): I'll draft required HSM integration docs + questions for Finlytics.

alex (product lead): Agree. If finance confirms ARR >100k we'll plan for HSM in phase1 and update estimates. Otherwise proceed with MVP plan.

mike (pm): Thanks everyone. Tagging @triage-bot to move ticket to "needs scoping". :thumbsup:

triage-bot: Ticket #INC-2026-314 status updated -> needs scoping.

jess (support): Noted — I'll update thread after sales reply. :eyes:
